description: Competitive benchmark corpus. Five real repositories that were NOT used to tune the Sentinel rubric (the calibration corpus in config/calibration_corpus.json is separate and its expectations came from code review). Chosen to span size, quality and archetype: a small mature library, a small clean web framework, a large docs-heavy framework, a mid-size test-driven tool, and a large weak-quality collection. `path` is relative to the repository root; `url` is recorded so the exact corpus can be rebuilt.
frozen_rules: Scoring is frozen for the round recorded in benchmarks/freeze.json. Nothing in this corpus may be used to adjust Sentinel's rubric.

repos.name: requests
repos.note: Small mature library. Aging conventions, fixture-heavy test tree, real complexity in adapters and sessions.

repos.name: flask
repos.note: Clean small framework core with strong tests and docs.

repos.name: fastapi
repos.note: Large docs-heavy framework; the original noise-control case (translated docs must not reach the top 5).

repos.name: pytest
repos.note: Mid-size, deeply tested, dense plugin architecture.

repos.name: thealgorithms-python
repos.note: Large weak-quality collection: thousands of contributed files, inconsistent conventions, very low test ratio. The only clearly negative example in the set.
